prompt: The IR spectrum below shows a very broad band from ~2500–3300 cm⁻¹ overlapping C–H, and a strong C=O around 1710 cm⁻¹. Which compound matches?
explanation: The extraordinarily broad O–H (2500–3300) from H-bonded COOH dimers overlapping with C–H is the DIAGNOSTIC signature of a carboxylic acid. Alcohols show a narrower, higher O–H (3200–3550). Ketones have no O–H. Ethers have no O–H and no C=O.
